socfpga_ddr.h

Public types for the bare-metal DDR driver, and the ddr_init() entry point.

Constants
DRAM bank count

How many DRAM banks the driver records.

CONFIG_NR_DRAM_BANKS

Value 1. Size of the bank table filled by ddr_init().

Types
phys_addr_t

A physical address. Stored as an unsigned long long.

phys_size_t

A memory size, in bytes. Stored as an unsigned long long.

fdt_addr_t

An address. This is another name for phys_addr_t.

ddr_info
struct
ddr_info

One DRAM bank. ddr_init() fills bank 0.

start

First byte of the bank. Bring-up stores DRAM_BASE here.

size

Length of the bank, in bytes. Bring-up stores the size reported by the controller.

ddr_init
int ddr_init(
void
)

Entry point for DDR setup. Examples and application code call this.

On an Agilex 5 OCRAM build, runs bring-up with DDR_PLATFORM_CONFIG as the handoff ddr_config value. On any other build, returns 0 and does not program the controller.

Returns

0 on success, or a negative error code from bring-up.
